steps.text: Hey ❤️ I've decided we never watched that film and my reputation is still intact
Good morning to you too, detective
Don't start, I haven't even had breakfast yet 😭
Would a red scarf make you feel better?
I will hide your remote the next time I come over
That sounds like a confession
It sounds like a warning 😌
Did you sleep well at least?
Yeah, once I stopped trying to work out how the actual ending made sense
It didn't
Good, then it wasn't just me
What about you? Better night?
Much better, and I got up and made breakfast before checking my phone
Without leaving a trail of things you'd dropped?
One spoon, but I picked it up
I'm proud of your very ambitious morning ❤️
I've also put both shoes on
Sitting down?
Sitting down
See, you can be taught 😌
How's your breakfast going?
It's fine, packing my bag is the problem
I'm taking last night's pasta so I don't get robbed by another sandwich
Future You finally got something out of that dinner
She got food and an extremely full bag
Put the food at the top
Then I have to carry the book
Carry the book
You make everything sound so easy when you're not the one trying to close this zip 😭
You could leave something at home
I need all of it
Including whatever's been sitting at the bottom for three weeks?
You don't know what's at the bottom
Do you?
That's not the point
Wait, I think I've got it
Please appreciate that I'm dressed and ready before the last possible minute
You look really good ❤️
Thank you handsome 😊
The bag looks like it's about to lose a fight
Compliment the girl, not the luggage
The girl is lovely. The luggage has my sympathy
Much better 😌
Classes this morning again?
Yeah, then straight to work
I'd like to get everything finished without staring at the clock for the last hour
A reasonable goal
What are you doing with your day?
Going to clear out that kitchen cupboard I've been avoiding
The one where things fall on you when you open it?
I prefer to think of it as a surprise feature
You could also just put fewer things in it 😭
I'm making space for the good coffee mugs
Important, I don't want our first proper coffee together to come out of a measuring jug
You've ruined my entire presentation
Save the effort for the coffee, I won't judge the mug too much ❤️
I'd rather take you out for one soon
I'd like that
All right, I need to leave before being early turns into missing the bus
I probably won't be on my phone much this afternoon
Don't forget your lunch after all that effort
It's already digging into my side, I couldn't forget it if I tried 😭
I'll text you when I get to the bar tonight, like I said
Okay, have a good day
You too handsome ❤️ Love you
Love you too
